note_on_truncation: Both values were supplied to me elliptically (the new one contains an unquoted '...'). The verdict below turns on the load-bearing, non-truncated claim of each string: old = 'Q is the source of the sphere E scatters'; new = 'E requires Q2'.

independent_computation.question: Per the cached wiki text, what does Syndra's E depend on, and is that dependency on Q or on the synthetic Q2 (second-charge) slot?

step_1_what_creates_a_Dark_Sphere.finding: Q (Dark Sphere) creates the sphere; R (Unleashed Power) also conjures 3 more. Nothing else creates spheres (W only grabs/throws an existing one).
quotes: abilities.Q[0].effects[0].description: 'Active: Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that appears after a 0.6-second delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.'
abilities.R[0].effects[1].description: 'Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones...'
abilities.W[0].effects[0].description: 'Active: Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster within 500 units...'

step_2_what_E_actually_requires.finding: E's own damage and knockback are UNCONDITIONAL - no sphere is needed to cast E or to have it hit. Only the STUN is sphere-mediated: a knocked-back Dark Sphere that hits an enemy stuns for 1.25 s. So the honest relation is conditional/CC-enabling, not a hard cast prerequisite.
quotes: abilities.E[0].effects[0].description: 'Active: Syndra propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies hit and knocks them back for 400 units and up to 800 units away from Syndra based on proximity, though not through terrain.' (no sphere mentioned)

abilities.E[0].effects[1].description: 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from Syndra based on proximity, knocking back enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds, during which they are also revealed, and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.'
abilities.E[0].notes: 'Once Scatter the Weak has been learned, an arrow directly in front of every Dark Sphere will appear to signify the direction the sphere will be knocked towards...'

step_3_what_Q2_is.finding: Q2 is not a wiki ability. data/champions.json exposes exactly five Syndra ability keys (P, Q, W, E, R). 'Q2' is a synthetic module slot standing for Q's SECOND CHARGE, which exists only after 40 Splinters of Wrath (Transcendent bonus). At <40 splinters Q2 does not exist at all.
quotes: abilities.Q[0].effects[1].description: 'Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.'
data/champion-audit/batch-6.json -> Syndra.module_slots.note: 'No MODULE_COVERAGE dict; hand-written module. modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge).'
data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json -> ammo atom description: '...stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)...'

derivation: E's CC (stun) requires ONE Dark Sphere in the cone. Any sphere satisfies it.
The base Q cast (available from level 1, at 0 splinters) produces such a sphere and it persists 6 s - long enough to be scattered.
Therefore the wiki-supported enabler for E's stun is Q (Dark Sphere), and secondarily R; it is NOT Q2.

Naming Q2 as the requirement is strictly stronger than the wiki supports, and is outright unsatisfiable below 40 Splinters of Wrath, where Q2 does not exist while E still casts, damages, knocks back, and stuns off the first sphere.
Even the word 'requires' overstates the coupling for E as a whole: E is castable and damaging with zero spheres on the field.
independent_computation.correct_value: The ordering source for E should cite Q as the sphere producer, e.g. Q's active row - 'Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location ... remains on the ground for 6 seconds' (data/champions.json abilities.Q[0].effects[0]) - paired with E's 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back ... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds' (abilities.E[0].effects[1]). The old leaf's claim ('Q Magic Damage - the sphere E scatters') is exactly this and is wiki-faithful; the new leaf's claim ('E requires Q2') is not.

verdict_rationale: Nothing in the cached wiki text makes Syndra's E depend on the second Dark Sphere charge. E casts, damages and knocks back with no sphere at all; its stun needs one sphere, which the base Q supplies at any splinter count. Q2 is a 40-splinter ammo slot with no wiki existence below that threshold, so 'E requires Q2' is both unsupported and unsatisfiable in the low-splinter regime. The old leaf named Q - the ability the wiki actually credits with conjuring the sphere E scatters - and is the wiki-faithful source for ordering Q before E.
caveats: The new value's elided '...' segment was not available to me; if that segment happens to quote the correct Q/E wiki text, the string would still carry the false headline claim 'E requires Q2', which is what I judged.

The new value cites a wiki revision tag (Syndra@4024662). That revision id appears nowhere in the exported data/ tree (not in data/wiki/article-index.json, which records pageid 641379 for Syndra, nor in data/staleness.json), so the citation could not be resolved against the cache.

If the intent was to record that E's CC is enabled by a Dark Sphere, the correct enabler slot is Q (and R, which conjures 3 spheres) - and the relation is conditional (stun only), not a cast prerequisite. A leaf worded 'E requires Q' would be defensible; 'E requires Q2' is not.
